question: Which Montgomery census tracts have the highest adult diabetes prevalence?

answer.sql:
SELECT t.name AS tract_name,
       CAST(m.diabetes_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) AS adult_diabetes_prevalence_percentage,
       CAST(m.totalpop18plus AS BIGINT) AS total_adult_population,
       t.geoid AS geoid
FROM fw_pg.tracts t
LEFT JOIN session.fw_9cbfc8_m1_cdc m
  ON m.tractfips = t.geoid
ORDER BY CAST(m.diabetes_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, t.name ASC
LIMIT 200

removed_sentences: Census Tract 6 and Census Tract 7 rank 2nd and 3rd with 28.5% and 28.2% respectively.
Tie groups exist at ranks 8, 30, 32, 35, 46, 51, and 60, where adjacent tracts share the same prevalence rate.

All 71 tracts have valid adult diabetes prevalence rates from the CDC PLACES 2025 release; rates are model-based estimates as percentages of adults; the highest and lowest values are 31.5% and 3.9% across the full cohort.
